command:
$ErrorActionPreference="Stop"
$repo=$env:FLYEXPLORER_CANONICAL_CHECKOUT
Set-Location -LiteralPath $repo
& git fetch origin main --no-tags --prune
if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){throw "baseline fetch failed"}
if((& git rev-parse refs/remotes/origin/main).Trim() -ne "ce51aa2804902990776071293990dad48a4ed1f1"){throw "main moved before corrected baseline capture"}
$temp=Join-Path $env:RUNNER_TEMP ("fly-search-content-regex-before2-"+$env:GITHUB_RUN_ID)
if(Test-Path -LiteralPath $temp){Remove-Item -LiteralPath $temp -Recurse -Force}
try{
  & git worktree add --detach $temp "ce51aa2804902990776071293990dad48a4ed1f1"
  if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){throw "baseline worktree add failed"}
  Set-Location -LiteralPath $temp
  & .\build.bat Release
  if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){throw "baseline Release materialization failed"}
  $exe=Join-Path $temp "out\winui\Release\flyExplorer.exe"
  if(-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $exe -PathType Leaf)){throw "baseline Release executable missing"}
  $evidence=Join-Path $repo "logs\remote-evidence"
  $owned=Join-Path $evidence "search-content-regex-before-owned"
  $left=Join-Path $owned "Left"
  $appdata=Join-Path $owned "appdata"
  $localdata=Join-Path $owned "localdata"
  $tmp=Join-Path $owned "tmp"
  foreach($p in @($left,$appdata,$localdata,$tmp)){New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $p | Out-Null}
  Set-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $left "readme.txt") -Value "owned baseline search fixture" -Encoding UTF8
  $script=Join-Path $env:RUNNER_TEMP "capture-search-content-regex-before2.py"
@'
from pathlib import Path
import ctypes as c
import ctypes.wintypes as W
import os, subprocess, sys, time
from PIL import ImageGrab
from pywinauto import Desktop

exe=Path(sys.argv[1]); left=Path(sys.argv[2]); owned=Path(sys.argv[3]); out=Path(sys.argv[4])
env={**os.environ,
     "APPDATA":str(owned/"appdata"),
     "LOCALAPPDATA":str(owned/"localdata"),
     "TEMP":str(owned/"tmp"),
     "TMP":str(owned/"tmp")}
u=c.windll.user32
CALL=c.WINFUNCTYPE(W.BOOL,W.HWND,W.LPARAM)
u.EnumWindows.argtypes=[CALL,W.LPARAM]
u.GetWindowThreadProcessId.argtypes=[W.HWND,c.POINTER(W.DWORD)]
u.GetWindowTextW.argtypes=[W.HWND,W.LPWSTR,c.c_int]
u.PostMessageW.argtypes=[W.HWND,W.UINT,W.WPARAM,W.LPARAM]
def ownedwindows(pid):
    found=[]
    @CALL
    def cb(h,_):
        p=W.DWORD(); u.GetWindowThreadProcessId(h,c.byref(p))
        if p.value==pid and u.IsWindowVisible(h):
            buf=c.create_unicode_buffer(700)
            u.GetWindowTextW(h,buf,len(buf))
            found.append((int(h),buf.value))
        return 1
    u.EnumWindows(cb,0)
    return found

proc=subprocess.Popen([str(exe),str(left)],cwd=str(exe.parent),env=env,
    stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL,stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL)
hwnd=None
try:
    deadline=time.time()+25
    while time.time()<deadline:
        if proc.poll() is not None:
            raise RuntimeError(f"baseline FlyExplorer exited before window: code={proc.returncode}")
        wins=[(h,t) for h,t in ownedwindows(proc.pid) if "flyExplorer" in t]
        if len(wins)==1:
            hwnd=wins[0][0]
            break
        time.sleep(.15)
    if hwnd is None:
        raise RuntimeError(f"baseline FlyExplorer HWND not found; owned={ownedwindows(proc.pid)!r}")
    win=Desktop(backend="uia").window(handle=hwnd)
    panel=win.child_window(auto_id="SearchPanelButton")
    if not panel.exists(timeout=5):
        raise RuntimeError("SearchPanelButton not found on owned HWND")
    win.set_focus()
    panel.click_input()
    scope=win.child_window(auto_id="SearchScopeBox")
    if not scope.exists(timeout=5) or not scope.is_visible():
        raise RuntimeError("SearchScopeBox not visible after opening search panel")
    time.sleep(.6)
    rect=win.rectangle()
    ImageGrab.grab(
        bbox=(rect.left,rect.top,rect.right,rect.bottom),
        include_layered_windows=True,
        all_screens=True,
    ).save(out)
    print(f"SEARCH_CONTENT_REGEX_BEFORE_SCREENSHOT={out}",flush=True)
    print(f"SEARCH_CONTENT_REGEX_BEFORE_WINDOW={rect}",flush=True)
finally:
    if proc.poll() is None:
        if hwnd:
            u.PostMessageW(W.HWND(hwnd),0x10,0,0)
        try: proc.wait(timeout=10)
        except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
            proc.kill(); proc.wait(timeout=5)
    print(f"SEARCH_CONTENT_REGEX_BASELINE_PROCESS_EXIT={proc.returncode}",flush=True)
'@ | Set-Content -LiteralPath $script -Encoding UTF8
  $shot=Join-Path $evidence "search-content-regex-before.png"
  & python -X utf8 $script $exe $left $owned $shot
  if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){throw "corrected baseline screenshot capture failed"}
  if(-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $shot -PathType Leaf)){throw "corrected baseline screenshot missing"}
  Write-Host "BASELINE_PRODUCT_REVISION=ce51aa2804902990776071293990dad48a4ed1f1"
  Write-Host "BASELINE_BUILD_EVIDENCE_REUSED=37535465831"
  Write-Host "BASELINE_VISUAL=PASS"
}finally{
  Set-Location -LiteralPath $repo
  if(Test-Path -LiteralPath $temp){& git worktree remove --force $temp}
  & git worktree prune
}
